versions.changelog:
- Expanded coverage to 85+ data sources across 6 engine categories, now including major finance, equities, on-chain, meme, exchange, market anomaly, and AI prediction sources.
- News skill is no longer limited to crypto; now covers real-time digital assets, U.S. equities, semiconductors, AI, commodities, macro/policy, and more.
- AI-powered: All news is analyzed with impact scores, trading signals, and bilingual summaries.
- Free access to many tools now possible without a token.
- Added strategy operations: query your strategy list and historical strategy-triggered events.
- Improved, detailed documentation for supported endpoints, WebSocket protocol, and source breakdown.

- Initial release of the OpenNews crypto news skill.
- Search and filter crypto news via the 6551 API, with support for keywords, coins, engine/source, and AI-based rating.
- Provides access to real-time updates via WebSocket feeds.
- Includes AI ratings, trading signals, and summary fields on articles.
- Requires an API token via the OPENNEWS_TOKEN environment variable.
